svg.aria-label: Architecture at a glance. How Superbee's private workspace layers become one supported installed package.
svg.title: Superbee architecture at a glance
svg.desc: The installed superbee package composes private host and projection packages plus reusable capabilities. Those packages depend inward on core, which owns bundle semantics and storage contracts. On the current main and next release line, publication modules and built UI assets are shipped beside the CLI without making private workspaces separate user installs.
